purpose: Availability-driven independent-region coverage check, with model choice already frozen
policy: Check Aphid record availability first, then retrieve Jassid only for sites with Aphid observations. Include all compatible paired windows from every available declared site; do not select a site by model scores. Report unavailable sites and missing classes. Verify source units, weather agreement and causal processing.
models: Frozen released LSTM, frozen validation-selected lstm32_dropout0.1 and original logistic comparator; no training or tuning on regional records
selection_history: candidate_validation.json and revision_1 record validation-only selection. historical_test_diagnostic.json is an already-inspected Akola comparison and is not independent validation.
scope: Retrospective regional evidence only. No real-world treatment or prospectively collected outcome claim. No automatic promotion.
